typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @R INT = ? SELECT \'T\' + CONVERT(CHAR(8),@R) + SPACE(130) AS TrailerRecord',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ODW
ODW sink(input(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DATA = TrailerRecord)) ~> INLTSSFile
